mapper.sql: apr07_alt_appr_id AS alt_appr_id, apr07_target_emp_id AS target_emp_id, apr07_alt_emp_id AS alt_emp_id, org.emp01_emp_no AS alt_emp_no, org.emp01_kor_nm AS alt_emp_name, f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS alt_org_name, f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'title_nm') AS alt_title_name, apr07_start_date::date AS start_date, apr07_close_date::date AS close_date, COALESCE(apr07_stamp_yn, 'false') AS stamp_yn, apr07_reason_cd AS reason_cd, apr07_emgr_point AS emgr_point
mapper.select: SELECT FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person tgt ON tgt.emp01_person_id = apr07_target_emp_id INNER JOIN emp01_person org ON org.emp01_person_id = apr07_alt_emp_id WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = #{empId} ORDER BY apr07_start_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr07_alt_appr ( apr07_alt_appr_id, apr07_target_emp_id, apr07_start_date, apr07_close_date, apr07_alt_emp_id, apr07_reason_cd, apr07_emgr_point, apr07_stamp_yn ) VALUES ( #{req.altApprId}, #{empId}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.closeDate}, #{req.altEmpId}, #{req.reasonCd}, #{req.emgrPoint}, #{req.stampYn} )
